synapseTable.publishedRowDescription: 3.2 million putative synapse detections between objects within the volume
synapseTable.qualityBoundary: Automated putative detections; the source states that many objects are not proofread and the table cannot be trivially interpreted as a connectivity graph. This CSV does not provide a per-row proofread flag.

accessAudit.reasonNotDownloaded: The public file is 388.8 MB; the MICrONS page advises contacting the project before large-scale downloads. No full-table transfer or credentialed query was performed.

nextEvidenceGate: Obtain an authorized root-ID-filtered query through the documented CAVE client or an official compact cell-specific export; do not download the full table as a substitute.

Keep automated detections distinct from proofread contacts; the table has no per-row proofread field.
